item.title: nuxt 4.7.0
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: If something breaks for you (and it might), please [open an issue](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/issues/new/choose) and mention Nitro v3. ❤️ Quote: …routes in the same way, and ends by suggesting where to deploy. Logs from Nuxt and modules stay inside the build output rather than breaking out of it ([nuxt/cli#1705](https://github.com/nuxt/cli/pull/1705)), and with [nitropack… Quote: One broken component no longer takes down the page: you get a `200`, the `#error` slot in its place, and the client hydrates into the same state. Release notes: https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/releases/tag/v4.7.0
